audit.summary: Walked all 5 days of /home/kkishore9891/Desktop/Andaman Trip/website/.claude/worktrees/bg-populate/data/itinerary.json against the R route table in /home/kkishore9891/Desktop/Andaman Trip/website/.claude/worktrees/bg-populate/populate_base.py: 37 events carry a "route" field, 28 are consistent (including legitimate reverse uses) and 9 are mismatched. Two clusters. (1) Day 1 Port Blair: the airport->town cab pair is off by one hop — cab-ixz-aberdeen actually ends at Icy Spicy in Junglighat, and the following cab-ixz-phoenix starts from Icy Spicy, not the airport (the known bug). (2) Neil Island, days 2-3, 7 of the 9: every Neil route in R is anchored at neil-jetty, but the crew sleeps at Blue Lagoon on the Sitapur side, 3.21 km away, so every hotel departure/arrival (check-in, Bharatpur, Laxmanpur hop, ride home, Sitapur sunrise out-and-back, Natural Bridge) draws the wrong line. Root cause: R contains no hotel-anchored or restaurant-anchored routes at all — 9 legs the itinerary actually travels have no route defined (ixz->icy-spicy, icy-spicy->phoenix-bay, neil-jetty->hotel-bluelagoon, hotel-bluelagoon->bharatpur, bharatpur->laxmanpur, pure-veg-neil->hotel-bluelagoon, hotel-bluelagoon->sitapur, sitapur->hotel-bluelagoon, hotel-bluelagoon->natural-bridge). No geographically impossible place sequence exists: every island change is covered by a ferry/flight and each day starts where the previous one ended. Deliberately NOT flagged as mismatches, all sub-1 km stand-ins or true reverse rides: hotel-bhuma vs govind-nagar (0.53 km), kayak-point vs govind-nagar (0.56 km), phoenix-bay vs aberdeen on day 3's Chidiya Tapu ride (0.93 km), hotel-atlanta vs aberdeen on the Baratang cab and day-5 airport cab (0.70 km), and the two "ride back to Govind Nagar" legs that end 1.33 km on at Something Different. Separate, non-route observations worth a look: day 2 03:20 "Ride to the kayak launch" is a travel event with no route at all (hotel-bhuma -> kayak-point); day 4 has no travel legs between hotel-atlanta, marina-park, cellular-jail and the 2.53 km hop to Icy Spicy; and the Port Blair scooters rented day 3 12:30 are never returned in the itinerary.

Observed values:
1. ixz->icy-spicy — forward: 650 m / 2 min via Great Andaman Trunk Rd; reversed: 650 m / 2 min via Great Andaman Trunk Rd. Reported 0.65 km / 2 min. Exact match (0%).
2. icy-spicy->phoenix-bay — forward: 3.0 km / 8 min via Foreshore Rd (alts 3.4 km/9 min and 4.0 km/9 min via VIP Rd); reversed: 3.0 km / 8 min via Foreshore Rd. Reported 2.6 km / 7 min via Great Andaman Trunk Rd. Deltas +15% km, +14% min — inside the ~20% band, so it passes, but this is the weakest leg: no "Great Andaman Trunk Rd" variant appeared among the three alternatives I saw, so the reported via-label looks off even though the magnitude holds.
3. phoenix-bay->chidiya-tapu — reversed: 25.8 km / 49 min via NH 4 (alts 26.6 km/49 min, 28.1 km/56 min). Reported 26.5 km / 49 min via NH 4. Delta -3% km, 0% min.
4. chidiya-tapu->hotel-atlanta — reversed: 25.0 km / 48 min via NH 4 (alts 26.2 km/49 min, 25.9 km/49 min). Reported 24.6 km / 46 min via NH 4. Delta +2% km, +4% min.
5. hotel-atlanta->jirkatang — reversed: 47.9 km / 1 hr 15 min via NH 4 (alts 49.4 km/1 hr 20 min; a 33.6 km/1 hr 19 min NH 4+SH10 variant). Reported 48.3 km / 79 min via NH 4. Delta -1% km, -5% min.

All five are within ~20% on both km and minutes, so the reported set is confirmed. Live traffic makes minute values drift a little between runs; the km figures are stable. Optional tightening: update leg 2 to "3.0 km, 8 min via Foreshore Rd" to match what Maps returns in both directions today.
